description:
*“Did you meet that bastard?”

“You mean that weakling parasite living off us? Did you meet him again?”*

Ju-Han, So-Eun’s first love and the executive director of Seohan, one of Korea’s leading corporations. Ju-Han has one secret he can’t tell anyone. He suffers from dissociative identity disorder, where his daytime personality differs from his nighttime one. So-Eun, who became the Seohan family's personal physician at the request of Tae-Geon, the Seohan chairman and someone like a brother to her late father, one day encounters Ju-Han's other personality. 

 *“Call me Ju-Han.”

“Just hold my hand. You don't have to do anything else, okay?”*

Unlike the sharp-eyed daytime Ju-Han, the nighttime Ju-Han burrows into So-Eun's embrace like a large dog, his eyes filled with longing. Despite being one person, So-Eun finds herself constantly swaying between daytime Ju-Han and nighttime Ju-Han... 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
